about: Stated as a hint and never as a claim about the world: if what is is a field of floors and ceilings, then a distant signature changes a cell whose own record never moved.
The cell holds one state in every one of two hundred trials and the verdict comes out both ways, so nothing stored at the cell explains the difference.
What explains it is elsewhere, in the bound the cell rests on.

cases.name: two hundred trials, one cell, one value

title: A distant signature moves a cell that did not move
